examples.arabic: ليلى نهضت بسرعة وشكرت العم أبو فادي، شعرت إنه كلامه كان وحكيماً وواضحاً جداً.
examples.english: Layla quickly got up and thanked Uncle Abu Fadi, feeling that his words were wise and very clear.
examples.transliteration: Layla nahadat bi sur'ah w shakarit el 'amm Abu Fadi, sha'arat inno kalamy kan wa hakiman w wadehan jiddan.
examples.storyTitle: Layla in Hamra: The Donation Journey

examples.arabic: ليلي عم تحاول تركز على مشروعها الهندسي المهم، بس صوت أخيها الصغير كان كتير عالي.
examples.english: Layla is trying to focus on her important architectural project, but her little brother's voice was very loud.
examples.transliteration: Layla a'am tahawil trakkiz 'ala mashru'aha al-handasi al-muhim, bas sawt akhiha al-saghir kan ktir 'ali.
examples.storyTitle: Layla's Quiet in the Family Home
